lines.text: Which drain cleaner actually eats a hair clog?
He drops hair and soap and grease and even tape into every product for twelve hours.
And the clear winner on hair is plain lye.
Because hair is made of protein and lye chops those protein chains apart until the clog dissolves.
beats: ai:macro of a single human hair dissolving in clear liquid
ai:glowing protein chains snapping apart macro

lines.text: Drano and Liquid Plumr tie with it because they're mostly lye too with some bleach.
The enzyme sticks just turn everything blue because bacteria work slowly over days.
beats: ai:tiny bacteria glowing under a microscope

lines.text: And the acids eat a carrot but also strip the plating off a steel pipe.
So acid works on food clogs but it attacks metal which is why it's only safe for plastic pipes.
beats: ai:a clean white plastic drain pipe under a bathroom sink

lines.text: Nothing touched the paper towel or tape so for solid stuff a drain snake beats every bottle here.
beats: ai:a metal drain snake coiled on a bathroom floor

lines.text: And never mix them because bleach plus acid makes toxic chlorine gas.
beats: ai:a toxic green cloud of gas rising from a bathroom sink

lines.text: So what's really clogging your drain?
